problem: Visual work can become split across SaaS workspaces, mock replicas and non-deterministic screenshots, making repository review and exact-SHA proof unreliable.
invariant: Accepted visual authority returns deterministically to the repository; composition precedes decorative assets; generated bridges are content-validated; workbenches reuse production components/formatting with deterministic fixtures, stable proof identifiers and asset-off inspection.
evidence: 4VELO PR #403 repo-owned style artifact with provenance/attribution guard
do_not_copy: Figma, Maputnik or Storybook as mandatory platform dependencies
4VELO map palette, route styling or mobile screen names
failure_behavior: Treat SaaS-only state as research-only; fail closed when authoritative generated artifacts drift, required provenance/attribution is missing, or deterministic workbench boundaries disappear.
